Show transcript National Constitution Center 66.7K subscribers VideosAboutFacebookInstagram Show less Why is the 14th Amendment important today?597 views597 viewsDec 3, 202513ShareSave 3 Comments Sort comments Sort by Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Add a comment... @udarpavarota396 4 months ago It depends on the interpretation of the amendment. That's what they're trying to change now. Show less Read more Like 1 Dislike Reply 1 reply Hide replies 1 reply @NeoCynics 4 months ago It made sense for the American slave. It was written in a time when the authors had no conception of what an automobile was, let alone a bus or Jumbo jet. The Jus Soli misrepresentation will undoubtedly be what destroys our democracy. Cultural Americans will and are being replaced, that will become exponential within this century. Ask yourself, should a child born to a Pakistani woman here on a tourist visa be classified as a citizen. Is that what the authors of the 14th intended? Should some one who hopped the border and caught a ride to the hospital to have us pay for the birth of their child be rewarded with automatic citizenship? Is that what the authors of the 14th intended on protecting? In the modern world the 14th is being weaponized, and we are allowing it and promoting it, based on a document that was put together when your feet or your horse were the transportation department. Wake up already. We've reached the point of necessary repeal.
